reason: S1 changes wuffs_base__status from a struct containing code to const char*. H0 still accesses z.code and therefore cannot use the S1 status API. This is a material, commit-induced harness compatibility gap, even though H0 otherwise invokes the same GIF and zlib decoding entry points.
evidence: S0 defines wuffs_base__status as a struct with int32_t code; S1 replaces it with typedef const char* wuffs_base__status.
gif_fuzzer.c:fuzz tests z.code after wuffs_gif__decoder__check_wuffs_version, wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_image_config, wuffs_base__pixel_buffer__set_from_slice, and wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame.
zlib_fuzzer.c:fuzz tests z.code after wuffs_zlib__decoder__check_wuffs_version and wuffs_zlib__decoder__decode, including comparison with WUFFS_BASE__SUSPENSION_SHORT_WRITE.

S1 production code demonstrates the new protocol with checks such as if (z), if (!status), and wuffs_base__status__is_suspension(status), and uses pointer constants such as wuffs_base__suspension__short_write.
recommended_action: Update both fuzz functions to treat wuffs_base__status as a nullable status string: replace z.code checks with pointer/status-helper checks, compare suspensions against the new status-string identifiers, and pass the status value rather than z.code to status reporting.
